notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 object-class Request Attribute Value Update overload over concrete subclass instances. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, rich FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies class-scoped owner solicitation, closest subscribed discovery class and producer, unique per-child provider callback with owned requested attributes and tag, and federation cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior. Native focused CTest passed 1/1; installed-package C++ primary/contract passed 4/4 direct runs and 4/4 focused CTests across both callback models (out/mgw/object-class-request-discovery-uniqueness-20261021.json). Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR, but provider runtime and conformance remain unverified.
